what_happened: Scene L9 (same kitchen as s2/s3/s18): large grey sponge_5 on white marble next to a dark holed cutting_board_2. Stage 0 normal: grasp 94 (width 0.067), carried ~14 cm onto the board (stage 0 from 97, online 112). For 94-188 the grasp test was False (finger_joint1 at its open limit, common with this wide sponge), so the counter could not count; grasp True 189-796. Stage 1: counter 1 at 215, 3 by 251. After that the policy kept the sponge over the board for the rest of the episode (wrist view: board under the sponge in every frame), but for most of it the sponge was not touching. Its centre was 4-8 cm above the counted-contact height during 300-530: the board looks smaller in the wrist view, and z is +0.04..+0.08 m against +0.039 at the first contacts. Low passes 560-714 still added nothing. Only 404 (4), 720 (5) and 732 (6) added points, and the criterion (5 contacts, sweep 0.231) was met only at 720. The gripper never opened (width 0.064-0.067 to 800), and there was no return move.
causal_chain: ~600 steps of 'scrubbing' mostly waved above the board (counter 3 at 251 -> 4 at 404 -> 5 only at 720) -> criterion first met at 720 -> no release before the 800 timeout. Even a release at a typical time (~450-600) would have failed with 4 contacts.
self_recovery: Partial: low passes from ~560 eventually brought the counter to 6 (720-732), but the policy never moved on to the release.
official_criterion_notes: Blind window 94-188 (finger-1 grasp test with the wide sponge_5) overlaps the carry and the first descent; small effect on the count.

packet_facts: sponge z +0.04..+0.08 m during 300-530 vs +0.039 at counted contacts

uncertain_about: Exact sponge-board clearance (sponge tilt varies 1-25 deg). The low counter while the sponge visibly travelled over new parts of the board with grasp=True makes 'not in contact' the only consistent reading.
